name: zls-letzebuergesch
description: Luxembourgish dictionary (LOD), spellchecker with n-rule hints, and the ZLS LB–FR–DE–EN translation corpus.
long_description:
Official Luxembourgish language resources from the Zenter fir d'Lëtzebuerger Sprooch (ZLS):

- **Lëtzebuerger Online Dictionnaire (LOD)**: search by word, inflected form or translation; full entries with DE/FR/EN/PT translations, examples, IPA, audio and conjugation/declension tables.
- **Spellchecker**: official orthography (spellchecker.lu dictionary) with suggestions and n-rule (Eifeler Regel) hints.
- **Multilingual corpus**: professionally translated Luxembourgish–French–German–English segments for usage in context.

Spellchecking and corpus search run locally; dictionary lookups send only the looked-up word to lod.lu.

tools.name: lod_search
tools.description: Search the Luxembourgish dictionary (LOD) by word, inflected form, or from DE/FR/EN/PT.

tools.name: lod_get_entry
tools.description: Full LOD entry: meanings, translations, examples, IPA, audio, n-rule form, synonyms.

tools.name: lod_get_inflection
tools.description: Conjugation and declension tables from LOD.

tools.name: lb_spellcheck
tools.description: Check Luxembourgish spelling, with suggestions and n-rule hints.

tools.name: lb_n_rule_check
tools.description: Check the n-rule (Eifeler Regel), optionally confirmed against LOD.

tools.name: corpus_search
tools.description: Search the ZLS LB–FR–DE–EN translation corpus for real usage in context.

tools.name: lb_check_draft
tools.description: Check a Luxembourgish draft: spelling, Germanisms, hunn/sinn, gender, dative, n-rule.

tools.name: lb_writing_guide
tools.description: ZLS rules for writing correct Luxembourgish.

tools.name: corpus_similar_sentences
tools.description: Closest professional translations for a source sentence.

prompts.name: proofread_luxembourgish
prompts.description: Proofread a Luxembourgish text with the ZLS tools.
prompts.text:
Proofread the following Luxembourgish text according to the official ZLS orthography, using lb_writing_guide, lb_check_draft and LOD lookups for doubtful words. Return the corrected text and a short list of changes.

${arguments.text}

corpus_path.title: Corpus file (optional)
corpus_path.description: Local copy of the Méisproochegen Iwwersetzungskorpus (.zip, .tmx or .jsonl). Leave empty to download it from data.public.lu on first use.
